pwd.syn: Print the current working directory path.

ls.syn: List directory entries (demo FS or Z Drive).

cat.syn: Print an entire file to the console.

head.syn: Print the first 10 lines of a file.

tail.syn: Print the last 10 lines of a file.

tree.syn: Print a recursive directory tree (demo FS only).

find.syn: Recursively list all paths under a start directory.

mkdir.syn: Create a directory on your Z Drive.

touch.syn: Create an empty file on Z Drive (or leave existing content).

rm.syn: Remove a file or directory on Z Drive.

rmdir.syn: Remove an empty directory on Z Drive (non-recursive).

cp.syn: Copy a file within Z Drive.

mv.syn: Move or rename a path within Z Drive.

echo.syn: Print text, or write/append to a Z Drive file with redirection.

grep.syn: Filter file lines matching a case-insensitive regex pattern.

df.syn: Show Z Drive (LabDrive) quota: used, free, and max.

zquota.syn: Show Z Drive (LabDrive) quota: used, free, and max.

quota.syn: Show Z Drive (LabDrive) quota: used, free, and max.

zshare.syn: Share a Z Drive file into the Community pool.

zunshare.syn: Remove a file from the Community share pool.

ip.syn: Show fictional LLC interface addresses, links, or routes.

ifconfig.syn: Friendly alias for the fictional address dump (`ip a`).

iw.syn: List wifi phy / interface info (nl80211-flavored fiction).

labcrack-ng-airmon.syn: Put the fictional Laden USB Wi‑Fi dongle into monitor mode.

airmon-ng.syn: Put the fictional Laden USB Wi‑Fi dongle into monitor mode.

labmon.syn: Put the fictional Laden USB Wi‑Fi dongle into monitor mode.

labcrack-ng-airodump.syn: Scan nearby fictional APs (requires monitor mode).

airodump-ng.syn: Scan nearby fictional APs (requires monitor mode).

labdump.syn: Scan nearby fictional APs (requires monitor mode).

labcrack-ng.syn: Educational WPA/WPA2 PSK cracker against demo .cap files.

aircrack-ng.syn: Educational WPA/WPA2 PSK cracker against demo .cap files.

lmap.syn: Laden Mapper — educational nmap-like scanner for fictional LLC nets only.

nmap.syn: Laden Mapper — educational nmap-like scanner for fictional LLC nets only.

mzfconsole.syn: Laden Metasploit-style framework REPL for fictional lab nets.

mzf.syn: Laden Metasploit-style framework REPL for fictional lab nets.

msfconsole.syn: Laden Metasploit-style framework REPL for fictional lab nets.

curl.syn: Alias of curl — same GET helper and scope lock.

wget.syn: Alias of curl — same GET helper and scope lock.

base64.syn: Encode or decode Base64 from a string or file.

rot13.syn: Apply ROT13 to a string or file contents.

xxd.syn: Hex-dump a string or file (16-byte rows with ASCII gutter).

jwt.syn: Decode a JWT header/payload (no signature verify) from token or file.

hashid.syn: Guess common hash algorithm families from a digest string.

md5.syn: Compute MD5 of a string or file contents.

sha1.syn: Compute SHA-1 of a string or file contents.

sha256.syn: Compute SHA-256 of a string or file contents.

labs.syn: List lounge challenges (difficulty, points, slug, title).

open.syn: Navigate the browser to a lab room by slug.

hint.syn: Print the current lab hint, or a general LLC challenge cheat-sheet.

id.syn: Print a demo uid/gid line for the current operator.

uname.syn: Print the fictional LLC kernel banner.

help.syn: Print the LLC command overview (filesystem, Z Drive, nets, helpers, session).

?.syn: Print the LLC command overview (filesystem, Z Drive, nets, helpers, session).

manuals.syn: Open or list the LLC manuals collection; man <tool> prints a short synopsis + URL.

man.syn: Open or list the LLC manuals collection; man <tool> prints a short synopsis + URL.
